title: Remulla flags Laos drug financier’s absence from Duterte-era watchlist

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla questioned why Sultan Edrieza Hadji Nasser Rimbang, described as the alleged “financier of the entire operation” behind a Laos drug shipment, was not included on the drug war watchlist under former President Rodrigo Duterte. “Ang pinagtataka ko lang kung bakit noong drug war, hindi kasama si Rimbang sa watchlist kung known drug element na siya dati pa,” said Remulla told reporters on Tuesday after the 20th Asean Ministerial Meeting on Transnational Crime.
